action.objective: Consolidate with Qg4, keeping the queen active and centralizing before Black's queenside play
action.rationale: h5g4 is the only commit_ready move and the verified broad-search best (exact -27 at depth 2). Verification at full depth 4: safety complete, no immediate mate-in-one reply, tactical refutation not_found. Qg4 retreats the queen from h5 (where f5g6 challenged it) to an active central square, attacking d4/d7/e6/f5/g5/h3 and defending f3. Black's likely Qxb4 grabs a pawn but White retains play with Bf1/Rc1 ideas; no stronger candidate exists among analyzed moves (c5d7 -76, c5a4 -118, f3f4 -359).
